gloss: to be stylish; to be fashionable; to dress up

definitions.gloss: to be stylish; to be fashionable; to be chic
definitions.explanation: To have a refined, tasteful, or fashionable quality. Most commonly used in its past participle form しゃれた as a modifier.

examples.japanese: しゃれた⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
しゃれた⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧しゃれた⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many stylish cafés around here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧しゃれた⟦{格好|かっこう}→格好：01800_kakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
Almost always appears in the past participle form しゃれた, functioning as a modifier meaning "stylish" or "chic." The kanji form ⟦{洒落|しゃれ}→洒落：00362_share⟧る exists but is rarely used. Related to the noun ⟦{洒落|しゃれ}→洒落：00362_share⟧ (wit, joke, pun), though the verb focuses on stylishness rather than humor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しゃれた⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a stylish shop
- しゃれた⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: fashionable clothes
- しゃれた⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: a chic atmosphere
- しゃれた⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧: a clever/witty name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おしゃれ→おしゃれ：02515_oshare⟧: stylish, fashionable — the more common everyday word for being well-dressed or trendy; derived from the same root
- ⟦{粋|いき}→粋：13773_iki⟧: chic, refined — carries a traditional Japanese aesthetic sensibility; suggests understated elegance
- スタイリッシュ: stylish — a loanword from English, used for modern/Western-style trendiness
